remarks: Welcome to this charming 2-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom top-floor condo in the highly sought-after Lake Tree Village community! This bright and well-maintained unit features an open-concept living and dining area with private balcony access, perfect for relaxing or morning coffee. Recent upgrades include a brand-new water heater (July 2026), newly installed flooring in both bathrooms, and a new garage door (Dec 2025)! Enjoy low-maintenance living with a dedicated 1-car detached garage (#41) plus an assigned outdoor parking space. Plus, take advantage of a spacious private basement for abundant extra storage, along with in-building laundry, central AC, and forced air heating. Unbeatable location just minutes from UB North Campus, shopping, dining, and major highways. Turnkey and ready for its new owner.
